sections.value:
PR #318 / F266: deployed AFTER performance receipt

Two consecutive live windows measured 20.2606 and 17.2457 observer captures/s, with 90.9254% and 92.2746% skipped. All daemon launch counters stayed flat. Drain-caused versus repair-caused extra captures are NOT measurable from this build's counters; neither D nor R is guessed.

Identity and method

Daemon PID 96429, deployed commit 3c14199f5150a24333fc227d7dca38d9ea072a65 (ping stamp 3c14199f51), process start November 21, 2026 14:50:26 UTC / November 22 00:50:26 UTC+10. PR #318 final head 47d828a9c33b855b7ad58eb7da9ecdc84fdac0a0, merged as 1de61eb38a4944da04603d55e21c80eda611ae29, is an ancestor of this deployed checkout. #321 is co-deployed.

Each boundary reads pij-rs --json ping, /usr/bin/uptime and /bin/ps -p 96429 -o pid=,etime=,lstart=,time=,%cpu=,rss=. Three ping readings define two consecutive intervals; elapsed time is monotonic between completed ping reads. No input, induced drain, repair, bounce, build or direct production SQLite access. The busy-polling machine launch probe ran separately afterward; no thread-CPU probe overlapped these windows.

Skip ratio is delta skipped / (delta skipped + delta captures). The unchanged nominal 600 ms observer tick produced 125 passes per window, approximately 1.666 passes/s. At the measured cohort, the added shared gate lookup scales to about 134 / 0.6 = 223.3 eligible-pane lookups/s nominal; no new loop or per-tick process launch was introduced.

All by_op spawn counters are identical at A, B and C. In particular tmux.control-client=1, tmux.pipe-pane attach=134 and tmux.set-options tap owner=134 remain flat. No counted attachment launch occurred in either window. These are existing launch-site counters, not a counter of repairs or capture causes.

Comparison, not causal attribution

#313's earlier AFTER, PID 16325 / 8b437897e3, measured 53.9413 captures/s and 84.8028% skipped at 213 decisions/pass. Here the capture rate is 20.2606 / 17.2457 and the skip ratio is 90.9254% / 92.2746%. The cohort is now 134, not 213; a mid-window fleet read reported 134 seats/panes (111 Claude, 18 Copilot, 5 OMP), 130 idle and 4 working, with no unavailable seat reads. The historical #313 load was 76.95 / 65.61 / 69.67 -> 81.95 / 69.94 / 71.06, and daemon age 01:17 -> 02:17. Current load, age, demand and cohort differ. A fleet-wide death event and co-deployed #321 further prevent attributing this aggregate decrease or whole-daemon CPU to #318 alone.

The stronger internal result is that 15230 and 15456 of 16750 capture/replay decisions avoided capture in their respective windows. Captures not solely due to the backstop numbered 1183 and 1047; these include multiple reasons and are NOT attributable D or R counts.

Proof ceiling: ObserverCountsView (crates/daemon/src/pane_observer.rs:31-54) exposes passes, active_us, captures, capture_bytes, skipped and backstop only. Drain started/ended state remains per-pane internal gate state; it is not exported through ping. There are no drain-start, repair-invalidation, in-flight pane-time, failed-capture or cause-attributed counters here. Captures count successful observer reads, not injection-owned reads or failed attempts. Aggregate capture minus backstop cannot recover the missing causes. The final verdict's short-drain 2D+R model and longer in-flight per-tick capture path are source models, not measured event rates. Relaxed atomic snapshots also permit small endpoint/field skew.

Separate whole-machine launch receipt

just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json, November 21 UTC 14:56:17 -> 14:56:37: daemon PID 96429; measured 20.0 s; 92.7 new PIDs/s, 90.9 sampled/s, 191328 in-process polls. Attributed lower bounds: other 78.6/s, gone-before-seen 12.3/s; no daemon children observed. This is a separate sample, not proof of zero daemon launches in all time or a matched historical machine saving. Short-lived children can escape attribution. Other seats' cargo activity was visible; this seat launched no builds.

Validation and harness feedback

Live identity, stable counters and ancestry were verified; product checkout stayed clean. harness checks --quick ran after these measurements, exit 1: eight dependency/tool failures (missing local tsx/vitest, unavailable type surface and incompatible ambient Biome); native contracts, SDK and pij-skill passed, attribution warned, and heavy Rust/route/smoke stages were skipped to preserve the no-build/read-only assignment. No local green code gate is claimed and no dependencies were installed.

magicWand: export drain starts/ends, tracked repairs, in-flight pane-time and capture causes through the existing ping receipt, without a new loop. difficulties: aggregate telemetry cannot split D from R; unmatched fleet load/cohort/age limits causal comparisons; dependency-free measurement checkouts cannot run the full code gate. This note completes the requested aggregate AFTER observation while explicitly retaining the cause-attribution proof ceiling.
